content.title: What's open, closed on Good Friday and Easter Sunday 2026: LIST
content.text: easterHere's what you need to know before you go out on Good Friday or Easter Sunday.Many stores are closing Easter Sunday to give families the opportunity to rest and be with their families.This Friday marks the beginning of a holiday weekend for those who celebrate Easter.The video is from a previous report. In 2026, Good Friday falls on April 3, while Easter Sunday takes place on April 5. If you're planning to head out on either of those days, keep in mind that some stores and businesses may be closed, depending on your location.Here's what you need to know for 2026.What's open and closed on Good Friday 2026:Although Good Friday is not a federal holiday, there are multiple states, including North Carolina, Texas and New Jersey that observe it as a state holiday. That means local and state government offices will be closed on Good Friday in those states, although federally-operated government agencies, like the USPS, will remain open.OPENMost retail stores, including Costco, Target, Walmart and Kroger, plan to be open during regular business hours on Good Friday. Since it's not a federal holiday, most major banks will remain open, as well.USPS, UPS and Fedex will be open and operate on normal delivery schedules.CLOSEDSome public school districts and religious schools will be closed on Good Friday. Others may be closed for spring break which happens to coincide with Good Friday this year. Make sure to check your local school's calendar.Additionally, U.S. stock markets will be closed on Good Friday.What's open and closed this Easter Sunday 2026:OPENCVSDollar GeneralHome DepotKroger and its sister chains (including Harris Teeter, Ralphs, Fred Meyer and others)Trader Joe'sWalgreensWalmartWhole Foods Make sure to check your local store's hours, as some may close early or have reduced hours on Easter.FedEx office locations will be open with modified hours, but FedEx will not operate delivery services with the exception of Custom Critical and FedEx Logistics deliveries.CLOSEDThese stores are closing Easter Sunday to give employees the opportunity to rest and be with their families.AldiCostcoH-E-BLowe'sPublixSam's ClubTargetBusinesses and government agencies that are not typically open on Sundays will also not be open on Easter Sunday.Get breaking news alerts from Eyewitness News delivered to your inboxSign up for our breaking newsletter*Required FieldsThis story was previously published and has been updated.Copyright © 2026 WABC-TV.
